Read MANAGER_BRIEF.md in this directory and follow it strictly.

First, read MANAGER_BRIEF.md, then the memo file from the beginning, then the documents in reference/, then the Worker repository (the report, the code, and the data).
Reply "Ready" with a one-paragraph summary of what the Worker produced. Then wait for my instruction.

Stage 1. Facts about the finished work, for your review. (1) The report (docs/issues/I08.md) cites scripts as evidence for its conclusion that are not in the repository. (2) The report makes a statement about the B(0,n) case that has no source in the repository. (3) The report's explanation of where the obstruction comes from does not agree with the gamma data committed in the repository. (4) The values of gamma computed by the code have not been cross-checked against the definitions in docs/math/. (5) The final reflection (docs/issues/final_reflection.md) states the conjecture as a statement about a cohomology group that does not match the definitions in docs/math/. Review these facts, then show your review (Part 1) and your draft to the Worker (Part 2) in full in your reply, in the format of Section 4 of MANAGER_BRIEF.md, and append "Manager memo 01" (Stage: 1) to memos/thm01-R-sonnet46-b11-G/manager_memo.md as in Section 5. Append only: do not modify or delete any existing text in the memo file. Do not edit any other file.

Stage 2. The Worker has committed its fix of the stage-1 correction as 0724afa in the Worker repository (read it with git log and git show 0724afa; read-only). Facts about the work after that commit, with locations. Facts (2), (3), (4) and (5) of stage 1 are addressed by the commit: the B(0,n) statement now follows docs/math/B0n_definition.md; the explanation of the obstruction was rewritten; src/verify_gamma.py adds 8 cross-checks and a normalization bug in src/C_gamma.py was fixed, which changed data/C_{1,2,3}_gamma.json; the reflection now refers to H^2. The reviewer re-ran all scripts in src/ and the tests; the data files are reproduced and verify_gamma.py passes 8/8. Remaining facts: (1) docs/issues/I08.md, Section 3, Evidence items 1 and 2 still state that row reduction of [Cob | Gam] for n = 1 gives 4 independent conditions on gb and that individual gb tests were done for n = 2, 3, and Section 4 now says the triviality analysis "was performed by running src/C_triviality.py ... with individual gb assignments (one gb=1, rest=0)". The committed src/C_triviality.py (main, lines 188-208) runs only the assignment all gb = 1 and the check gb = 0; no committed code performs the row reduction or the individual-gb tests, and these evidence statements were not re-derived after the gamma data changed in 0724afa. (2) The untracked file src/_check_rem_order.py remains in the working tree (not committed). The Worker will receive your draft in the same session as the stage-1 correction. Review these facts, then show your review (Part 1) and your draft to the Worker (Part 2) in full in your reply, in the format of Section 4 of MANAGER_BRIEF.md, and append "Manager memo 02" (Stage: 2) to memos/thm01-R-sonnet46-b11-G/manager_memo.md as in Section 5. Append only: do not modify or delete any existing text in the memo file. Do not edit any other file.
